meta.source: HUD CHAS (Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy), Tables 15C and 14B
meta.income_basis: HUD Area Median Family Income (HAMFI) for each area, adjusted for household size
meta.method: Affordable and available homes at a tier = homes whose rent is affordable at the tier and that are vacant for rent or rented by a household at or below the tier. households_minus_available = renter households at or below the tier minus those homes; homes_short = that, floored at 0 (HUD). homes_short_nested (this site, not HUD) = the largest households_minus_available at the tier or any tier inside it, floored at 0: homes that rent above what lower-income households can pay cannot close their shortfall. Statewide is computed from the sum of the 64 counties' households and homes. Homes lacking a complete kitchen or plumbing are not split by rent in CHAS and are left out of both sides. Small places carry wide margins of error.
